description: This file defines the IndiceActivity class, an Android activity responsible for displaying an index screen with text and a CTA button that navigates to another activity while passing a content ID.

classes.name: IndiceActivity
classes.description: An Android activity displaying an index or introductory screen with a header, description, CTA button, and navigation logic to another activity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, binds UI components, sets text content, and defines the click behavior for the CTA button.
